thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 01/30/2019: JNPR, AMD, MLNX, INTC, MSFT, AAPL, CSCO, IBM, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 01/30/2019: JNPR, AMD, MLNX, INTC, MSFT, AAPL, CSCO, IBM, GOOG
text:
Most technology stocks were rallying pre-market Wednesday.
Early movers include:
(-) Juniper Networks ( JNPR ), which was down more than 10% as it recorded Q4 non-GAAP net income of $205.7 million, for $0.59 per diluted share, higher than the previous year's $199.4 million, or $0.53 per diluted share, and exceeding consensus estimates of $0.57 per share.
(+) Advanced Micro Devices ( AMD ) was over 9% higher after saying Q4 non-GAAP earnings was $0.08, in line with the consensus on Capital IQ and up from $0.01 a year earlier.
(+) Mellanox Technologies ( MLNX ) was gaining more than 8% in value after financial news paper Calcalis t report ed that Intel ( INTC ) is courting the Israeli-based chip maker with an offer of up to $6 billion in cash and stock.
